name: github_issue_pr_manager
description: Lists repository issues and pull requests, and can create issues or comments via the GitHub REST API.

action.description: Action to execute: list_issues, list_pull_requests, create_issue, create_issue_comment

repo.description: Repository in owner/repo format, e.g. tarunjandra/agent-tools-mcp-hub

state.description: Filter state for listing actions: open, closed, or all

per_page.description: Items per page for list actions (1-100)

include_pull_requests.description: For list_issues action, include PR-type items from issues endpoint

issue_number.description: Issue or PR number for create_issue_comment action

github_token.description: Optional override token. Defaults to GITHUB_TOKEN env var.
